title: Introduce theming-aware interruptible progress overlay for icon and compact actions
creator: Asha Menon
description:
Problem: Several product teams reported visual regressions and accessibility issues when long-running actions are indicated on icon-only and compact buttons. Current approaches either add inline spinners that shift layout or overlay global loaders that feel heavy for micro-actions. We need a consistent, theme-aware progress affordance that: (a) doesn't cause layout shift, (b) adapts to high-contrast and dark/light theme tokens, (c) supports an explicit interrupt/cancel affordance, and (d) has clear migration guidance for existing button variants.

Scope: Design and spec a small overlay spinner anchored to the button's interior (not outside the hitbox), plus an optional micro-cancel control. Implement token fallbacks for legacy themes and ensure RTL + reduced-motion + high-contrast parity. Work includes tokens, component API suggestions, accessibility annotations, visual specs, QA checklist, and rollout strategy with telemetry and a small migration guide for engineers and product teams.

Why this matters: Micro-actions (favorites, inline saves, quick toggles) are core to many flows; visual regressions there are highly visible and increase support noise. A consistent contract will reduce bespoke implementations and regression risk.
acceptance_criteria: Design spec includes: overlay placement rules, colors and opacities for light/dark/high-contrast, token mapping table for expressive/compact modes, and micro-cancel behavior.
Prototype (Figma) demonstrates no layout shift across size scales (compact/regular/large) and in RTL.
A11y: spinner has programmatic label and role; cancel control is keyboard focusable and announced; reduced-motion respects OS preference.
Engineering API proposal: props for {loading, interruptible, overlayMode:'inline'|'anchored', spinnerSize}, and migration notes for existing .loading variants.
Cross-theme token fallback: if expressive tokens missing, fall back to neutral tokens with documented overrides.
Design review approval obtained and PR opened that implements CSS/API changes with visual regression tests and storybook examples.
Telemetry: events emitted for progress_shown and progress_cancel with minimal payload spec in the ticket.
QA pass: manual verification across Chrome/Safari/Firefox, Mac/Win with high-contrast and reduced-motion, and automated visual snapshots added to CI.
Rollout plan documented with feature flag gating and migration notes for client teams.
Updated docs: component README with code examples and migration guide added to the design system site.
engineering_notes:
Key engineering trade-offs and guidance:
- Prefer an absolutely-positioned overlay inside the button container to avoid reflow; use pointer-events appropriately to allow cancel control to receive events.
- Spinner color should reference token: component.progress.foreground; background dim uses component.progress.backdrop with alpha. Provide fallback tokens: component-legacy.progress.* for older themes.
- Provide a small JS hook to manage optimistic UI timing and cancel semantics (expose onCancel callback).
- Keep implementation CSS-only for basic cases to avoid bundling runtime unless interruptible behavior requested.
- Add visual-diff snapshots for compact/icon/regular states and RTL.
- Add telemetry: "progress_shown" (key, variant, interruptible boolean) and "progress_cancel" (key, reason). Limit payload to strings to avoid PII.
- Ensure API is ergonomically composable in React and vanilla HTML; show examples in Storybook.
qa_checklist: Verify no layout shift when toggling loading for icon-only, compact, and regular buttons.
Confirm overlay color/contrast in light/dark/high-contrast meet AA/AAA as appropriate.
Test keyboard navigation: focus order, activation, cancel via Enter/Escape, and screen reader announcements.
Validate reduced-motion: spinner replaced with subtle pulsing or hidden per OS setting.
Exercise token fallback: remove expressive tokens in a dev theme and ensure graceful fallback.
Check RTL: spinner origin and cancel placement mirror correctly.
Run visual-diff snapshots and ensure no unintended regressions in other button stories.
Confirm telemetry events are emitted with expected keys and rate-limited in dev mode.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): Merge design + CSS into ui-kit behind feature flag; include storybook examples and visual snapshots. Notify two internal product teams to pilot. Phase 2 (wider): After 2-week canary and no regressions, flip feature flag by default in ui-kit release ui-kit-2026.03. Phase 3 (migration): Publish migration guide and deprecate legacy .loading-inline classes in next minor (ui-kit-2026.06) with a codemod for common patterns. Maintain backwards-compatible token aliases until deprecation window ends.
